αἴσιμα: αἴσιμος — fitting, right, according to what is destined; neut. acc. pl., object of εἰδώς: ’what is fitting’ · also object of τίσειν: ’everything that is fitting, what is due’ · also object of τίουσι, neut. acc. pl., agreeing with ἔργα: ’the proper deeds’ (αἴσιμα ἔργ’ ἀνθρώπων) · also neut. nom. pl., subject: ’all that is fitting, in due measure’ (ἀμείνω δ’ αἴσιμα πάντα) · also neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’in due measure’ (μηδ’ αἴσιμα πίνῃ ’and does not drink in due measure’)
βὰς: βαίνω — go, step, walk; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., root aorist (ἔβην): ’having stepped, stepping’
γαστέρι: γαστήρ — belly, stomach; fem. dat. sg.
γλαυκώπιδος: γλαυκῶπις — gleaming-eyed (standing epithet of Athena); fem. gen. sg.
γούνασιν: γόνυ — knee; neut. dat. pl., epic γούνασιν (= Attic γόνασι)
δοκέει: δοκέω — seem, think; pres. 3 sg., uncontracted (= Attic δοκεῖ)
δόμοιο: δόμος — house; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
ζωὸν: ζωός — alive, living; masc. acc. sg., epic (= Attic ζῶν): ’alive’, agreeing with σε
θέων: θέω — run, speed; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ‘speeding’
κάρτιστον: κάρτιστος — best, mightiest; epic superlative (= Attic κράτιστος); neut. nom. sg., predicate
κήδεαι: κήδομαι — care for, be concerned for (+ gen.); pres. 2 sg. mid., epic uncontracted (= Attic κήδῃ)
κατελθέμεν: κατέρχομαι — go down, come down; aor. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic κατελθεῖν)
κειμήλια: κειμήλιον — treasure, thing laid up, keepsake (from κεῖμαι); neut. nom./acc. pl.
κληῗδι: κληΐς — bolt, bar, key; fem. dat. sg., epic (= Attic κλείς, dat. κλειδί): ’with a bolt’
κοῦρον: κοῦρος — boy, son; masc. acc. sg., Ionic-epic (= Attic κόρος)
μέγιστος: μέγας — great; superl. masc. nom. sg.: ’greatest’
μελάνθιον: Μελάνθιος — Melanthius, the goatherd; masc. acc. sg.
νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
νύμφη: νύμφη — nymph, young bride; nom. sg.
οἰκία: οἰκίον — house, home (Homer only in neut. pl. οἰκία, collective, = Attic οἰκία fem. sg.); neut. acc. pl.
παραστὰς: παρίστημι — stand beside; aor. part. masc. nom. sg., root aorist: ’standing beside’
πεποίηται: ποιέω — make, prepare; perf. mid./pass. 3 sg.: ’has been made, is ready’
πλεῖστα: πολύς — much, many; superlative πλεῖστος, neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’most, the greatest amount’
πολύκμητός: πολύκμητος — much-wrought, laboriously worked; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
πρηνὴς: πρηνής — face down, headlong; masc. nom. sg.
πᾶσαν: πᾶς — all, every; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with ἰθύν: ’for every (undertaking)’ · also ’the whole’ (of a single extent, not distributive ’every’): πᾶσαν ἠοίην ’the whole morning’, acc. of duration · also agreeing with ὑπερβασίην: ’all, the whole of’ (πᾶσαν … ὑπερβασίην ’all their transgression’)
στόμα: στόμα — mouth; neut. acc. sg.; also used of a river’s mouth
τέκ: τίκτω — beget, bear; aor. 3 sg. act., elided, unaugmented (τέκ’ = ἔτεκε): ’begot’
τροχὸν: τροχός — wheel, round disc; masc. acc. sg.
υἱέ: υἱός — son; masc. voc. sg. (Ἀτρέος υἱέ ’son of Atreus’)
φέροι: φέρω — bring, carry; pres. opt. 3 sg. act., purpose clause: ’might bring, would bring’ · also with κεν, potential: ’it would bear’ (φέροι δέ κεν ὥρια πάντα ’it would bear all things in season’)
φιλέεσκεν: φιλέω — love, be fond of; impf. iterative 3 sg., epic -εσκεν, uncontracted and unaugmented: ’used to love’
φόνοιο: φόνος — murder, slaughter; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου), after λήγω: ’from slaughter’ · also gen. sg. dependent on a noun: ’of the killing’ (παίδων τε κασιγνήτων τε φόνοιο ἔκλησιν ’forgetting of the killing of sons and brothers’)
φύγοι: φεύγω — flee, escape; aor. opt. 3 sg., within an indirect question
φὰν: φημί — say, think, believe; impf. 3 pl., epic unaugmented (= ἔφασαν), + inf.
χαλκήρεα: χαλκήρης — fitted with bronze; neut. acc. pl.
χρυσός: χρυσός — gold; masc. nom. sg., accented before the enclitic τε
ἀμύμονι: ἀμύμων — blameless (the real sense is not known); fem. dat. sg. (two-ending adj.)
ἀναγκαίη: ἀναγκαῖος — necessary; fem. ἀναγκαίη as a noun, necessity (= ἀνάγκη); fem. nom. sg., Ionic -η
ἀπηύρα: ἀπαυράω — take away, rob, deprive of; aor. 3 sg., unaugmented, with an impf.-looking ending: ’took away’
ἀφνειοῦ: ἀφνειός — wealthy, rich; masc. gen. sg.
ἁπάσας: ἅπας — all, quite all; fem. acc. pl.: ’all of them’
ἐκέκλετο: κέλομαι — command, call to; reduplicated aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, + dat.: ’called to, bade’
ἐλεήσῃ: ἐλεέω — pity, have mercy; aor. subj. 3 sg., in a condition after αἴ κε: ’if he take pity’
ἐπείγει: ἐπείγω — press, drive, urge on; pres. 3 sg.
ἔλατον: Ἔλατος — Elatus, a suitor; masc. acc. sg.
ἔμελλε: μέλλω — be about to, be destined to (+ inf.); impf. 3 sg.: ’was destined, was about to’
ἔσκεν: εἰμί — be; impf. iterative 3 sg. (-σκε(ν) suffix): ’used to be’ · also impf. 3 sg. with no iterative force: ’there was’ (ὀρσοθύρη δέ τις ἔσκεν ’there was a raised door’)
ἤρκεσε: ἀρκέω — be enough to ward off, avail, suffice; aor. 3 sg., augmented, + acc./dat.: ’warded off, availed against’
ἥρω: ἥρως — hero; masc. acc. sg., elided ἥρω’ (= ἥρωα)
ἰθύν: ἰθύς (noun) — a direct course, an undertaking, a purpose; fem. acc. sg., distinct from the homographic adverb ἰθύς ’straight’
ἱερευσέμεν: ἱερεύω — sacrifice; fut. inf., epic -έμεν (= Attic ἱερεύσειν), used as an imperative · also fut. inf. in a promise, in indirect speech after γουνούμην: ’(promising) to sacrifice’
ὁδῷ: ὁδός — road, way; fem. dat. sg.
ὄεσσι: ὄϊς — sheep; masc./fem. dat. pl., epic -εσσι (= Attic οἰσί)
ὄρχαμον: ὄρχαμος — chief, leader (+ gen. ’of men’); masc. acc. sg.
ὑπέρθυμοι: ὑπέρθυμος — high-spirited, high-hearted; masc. nom. pl.
ὑπεκφύγοι: ὑπεκφεύγω — escape from; aor. opt. act. 3 sg., potential with κέν: ’might escape’ · also optative of wish after μηδ’: ’may he not escape’
ὑποκυσαμένη: ὑποκύω — conceive; aor. part. mid. fem. nom. sg.: ’having conceived’
ὔμμι: σύ (pl. ὑμεῖς) — you; epic encl. dat. pl. ὔμμι (= Attic ὑμῖν): ’to/for you’
